_what: SGBM tuning for experiment 5. A coordinate-descent search over dense_stereo.py's SGBM settings, scored against the tag planes (board_truth.py) on frames NOT used by the depth comparison: other passes of the shade pyramid and S30 frames offset from the test set. The winner becomes the sgbm_tuned matcher in config.json.

sets.name: s30_tune
sets._frames: Every 50th from frame 12: none of them is one of the test set's every-25th from 0.

_objective: Mean over the scenes of the F1 of precision and recall on the tag regions, so S30 (larger regions) and the ice count equally. S30 is one scene; pyr1_pass2 and pyr1_pass3 are averaged into one ice score first.
_workers: SGBM's full 8-path mode (hh) holds the whole cost volume: 3.0 GB peak per process on a full-size S30 frame (384 px search). 4 workers fit the ~12 GB free on this 30 GB machine.

start._why: dense_stereo.py's defaults, so the search starts from (and is compared with) the current pipeline.
